title: Estimates of Expenditure for the Financial Year 1 April 2021 to 31 March 2022
what_it_is: Estimates of Expenditure for the Financial Year 1 April 2021 to 31 March 2022

sections.label: Estimates totals and guillotine times
sections.summary: The totals for each Head of Expenditure are taken from the Main and Development Estimates for FY2021, with 569 amendments submitted and guillotine times set under Standing Order 92(7)(a).

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: For convenience, I shall take the totals for each Head of Expenditure in the Main and Development Estimates as they appear in the last columns of the schedules of estimated expenditure under the Main and Development Estimate outlays for FY2021 on pages 6 and 7 respectively of the Command Paper.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: A total of 569 amendments to the Estimates of Expenditure have been submitted this year.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: The "guillotine times" to the discussion of the Heads of Expenditure under Standing Order 92(7)(a) have taken into consideration the earlier commencement time of a Sitting, the reduction of Question Time and the extension of Sitting times of the Committee of Supply for each allotted day.
